summary.oneLiner: A Bengaluru-based precision engineering company making machined components, sheet metal parts and integrated assemblies for mission-critical railways, aerospace, defence and semiconductor applications.
summary.business: Millworks manufactures precision-engineered components and sub-assemblies used in regulated, mission-critical applications across aerospace, defence, railways and semiconductor machinery. It operates under Build-to-Print (BTP) and Build-to-Spec (BTS) engagement models, plus job-work arrangements, and primarily supplies Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). In fiscal 2026 revenue from operations was Rs 14,876.70 lakhs, of which 27.47% was exports to customers in 9 countries.

currentContext.business: Millworks manufactures precision-engineered components and sub-assemblies used in regulated, mission-critical applications across aerospace, defence, railways and semiconductor machinery. It operates under Build-to-Print (BTP) and Build-to-Spec (BTS) engagement models, plus job-work arrangements, and primarily supplies Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). In fiscal 2026 revenue from operations was Rs 14,876.70 lakhs, of which 27.47% was exports to customers in 9 countries.
currentContext.expansion: The Company intends to fund capital expenditure to purchase additional Plant and Machinery (up to Rs 6,103.25 lakhs from IPO proceeds) to augment its four Bengaluru manufacturing units, alongside funding working capital requirements. Installed capacity was 1,63,952 hours in FY24 (91,450 hours utilized) and increased by 57,358 hours in FY25.
